object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: With Document Editors open on a parent and a child document joined by one OK link, revise the parent object without committing, then commit the revision from the parent's window and activate the child's window. Expected: before the commit the parent object's link is still OK; after it, the parent's window shows the link suspect at once, and on activation the child's state gutter marks the source object suspect and the suspect banner shows.
